summary: Independently regenerated AC1 through AC9 evidence at candidate b234861. All acceptance probes and npm run check passed. No technical findings.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: AC1 AC9 tests at 1280 × 700, 768 × 1024, and 390 × 844 passed for all three metrics. Inspected generated history screenshots against prototypes/desktop.png, tablet.png, and smartphone.png. Both dates appear below values without interaction, clipping, or horizontal page overflow.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: winter-midnight and summer-midnight scenarios passed for all metrics with 07 Jan · 00:35 and 07 Jul · 01:35.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: two-sensors-and-single-measurement scenario passed. Sensor A temperature dates were 06 Oct · 08:00 / 06 Oct · 10:00, humidity and dew point reversed them, and all Sensor B dates were 06 Oct · 11:00.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: unordered-ties scenario passed with Low 06 Oct · 08:00 and High 06 Oct · 11:00 for all metrics. Additional node --input-type=module assertions verified original-value comparisons and earliest dates from 1801 pre-sampling rows for temperature, humidity, and dew point.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: range-change scenario passed. Switched Last day through Last 12 hours to Last 6 hours; temperature Low changed from 05 Oct · 22:00 to 06 Oct · 10:00 with 18.0°C.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: before-refresh and after-refresh scenarios passed. Refresh with changed latest readings and history changed temperature High from 06 Oct · 12:00 to 06 Oct · 14:00 with 26.0°C.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: unit-change scenario passed. Fahrenheit switch preserved all six dates and changed temperature and dew point Low to 64.4°F and 46.4°F; humidity remained 40%.

npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: empty-history scenario passed at Last 6 hours. All three charts retained No measurements in this range., both placeholders, and no time elements.
npm run test:e2e -w @wx/web -- metric-extreme-dates.spec.ts: AC1 AC9 tests passed at all three target sizes. All six extreme dates and the header date had computed font-size 13px.

notes: Confirmed exact candidate HEAD and verifier-running workflow before verification. Read approved spec, HTML and static prototypes, applicable instructions, builder handoff, and E1 resolution.
